description.fr-FR: Les petits ouvrages de Jean Eudes sur les Sacrés Cœurs de Jésus et de Marie : la dévotion au Cœur de Marie et ses offices, la Confrérie du Cœur de Jésus et de Marie, le Manuel des Écoliers de Lisieux et le Règlement de la Société du Cœur de la Mère admirable.
description.en-US: John Eudes’s shorter works on the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary: the devotion to the Heart of Mary and its offices, the Confraternity of the Heart of Jesus and Mary, the Manual of the Scholars of Lisieux and the Rule of the Society of the Heart of the Admirable Mother.
description.pt-BR: Os pequenos escritos de João Eudes sobre os Sagrados Corações de Jesus e de Maria: a devoção ao Coração de Maria e seus ofícios, a Confraria do Coração de Jesus e de Maria, o Manual dos Escolares de Lisieux e o Regulamento da Sociedade do Coração da Mãe admirável.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 8, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
